svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A tissue slice with 1200 cells plotted at their real positions, coloured by the cluster found from expression. The clusters form three concentric rings: a purple core in the centre, an orange rim around it, and a blue edge on the outside.
svg.text: The clusters, placed back on the tissue
Each dot is a cell at its real position, coloured by the cluster found from gene activity alone.
We never gave the position to the clustering. Yet the clusters line up as neat concentric zones: real tissue structure.
